Preparing for Freneskae

blocks.html: Put on a face mask or equivalent protection to avoid taking 50 damage every 15 seconds while in Freneskae.
blocks.text: Put on a face mask or equivalent protection to avoid taking 50 damage every 15 seconds while in Freneskae.

blocks.html: If you have completed Mahjarrat Memories (miniquest), you should also bring the fully charged engrammeter. Operating the engrammeter on Freneskae will cause it to become a distorted engrammeter, which provides a 15% reduction to lightning damage on Freneskae and a one-time reward of 25,000 Divination experience.
blocks.text: If you have completed Mahjarrat Memories (miniquest), you should also bring the fully charged engrammeter. Operating the engrammeter on Freneskae will cause it to become a distorted engrammeter, which provides a 15% reduction to lightning damage on Freneskae and a one-time reward of 25,000 Divination experience.

blocks.html: Enter the World Gate to enter Freneskae.
blocks.text: Enter the World Gate to enter Freneskae.

blocks.html: Do not log out while inside Freneskae or you will restart just outside the World Gate. There is a checkpoint after each section.
Run through Freneskae using the map below to reach the Sanctum. Move fast and avoid the hazards. There are healing points along the way if needed.
blocks.text: Run through Freneskae using the map below to reach the Sanctum. Move fast and avoid the hazards. There are healing points along the way if needed.

blocks.html: Optional: collect the memoriam crystals along the way. They are numbered on the map below; for efficiency, start with collecting number 9, then 2, 1, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8.

blocks.html: Go to the north side of the room to the door puzzle.
blocks.text: Go to the north side of the room to the door puzzle.

blocks.html: Match the symbols up together to light up the lines in between them three times to open the door, then enter.
blocks.text: Match the symbols up together to light up the lines in between them three times to open the door, then enter.

blocks.html: Kill the four nihils then enter the next area to the north. All nihils use a special attack after hissing. Each nihil always runs in the same direction. Therefore, a pair of nihil (ice and shadow or smoke and blood) can be killed first, leaving areas between the tracks unused and safe. Don't stand in the middle, as you might be dashed by multiple nihils at once.

Therefore, a pair of nihil (ice and shadow or smoke and blood) can be killed first, leaving areas between the tracks unused and safe. substeps.html: Killing the nihils while all 4 are attacking you will unlock the title [Name] the Annihilator and the achievement Annihilator.
substeps.text: Killing the nihils while all 4 are attacking you will unlock the title [Name] the Annihilator and the achievement Annihilator.

substeps.html: The smoke nihil attacks with Magic. Its special attack will decrease Attack, Strength, Magic, Ranged, and Defence by 15. Its charge will decrease these stats by 5.
substeps.text: The smoke nihil attacks with Magic. Its special attack will decrease Attack, Strength, Magic, Ranged, and Defence by 15. Its charge will decrease these stats by 5.

substeps.html: The shadow nihil attacks with Ranged, and its special attack creates Nex-like shadow bomb at the position of player that deals rapid damage. Players should move away as soon as the floor below them is darkened by a circular spot. Shadow nihil darkens the whole screen whenever it approaches the player, both when charging or fighting the player, but this causes no gameplay difference.
substeps.text: The shadow nihil attacks with Ranged, and its special attack creates Nex-like shadow bomb at the position of player that deals rapid damage. Players should move away as soon as the floor below them is darkened by a circular spot. Shadow nihil darkens the whole screen whenever it approaches the player, both when charging or fighting the player, but this causes no gameplay difference.

substeps.html: The blood nihil attacks with melee. Its special attack causes all incoming damage to heal it, indicated when the creature lowers its head and begin to glow. It also will passively heal other nihil if it is damaged. Its charge inflicts a bleed similar to Slaughter that begins at 100 damage.
substeps.text: The blood nihil attacks with melee. Its special attack causes all incoming damage to heal it, indicated when the creature lowers its head and begin to glow. It also will passively heal other nihil if it is damaged. Its charge inflicts a bleed similar to Slaughter that begins at 100 damage.

substeps.html: The ice nihil attacks with Magic, and its special attack applies a six second stun and drains player's Prayer points by 50% of its maximum. Its charge drains the player's Prayer points by 25% of its maximum.

blocks.html: Collect The Measure and place it on the ground near faint wisps to activate them for harvesting (wisps can be found on the centre and edges of the cave. After revealing one, it will be a yellow dot on minimap).
